job_description:
About CookieYes

CookieYes helps website owners navigate privacy compliance, turning complex regulations into clear, conversion‑driving messaging.

Role: UX Writer (Growth Team)

We are hiring a UX Writer to own the words across all growth surfaces. This is a conversion‑focused writing role, not product documentation. You will write and test copy on the website, landing pages, lifecycle emails, paid campaigns, pricing pages, and upgrade flows, and you will be measured on the impact on key metrics.

Responsibilities

  • Own copy across all growth surfaces: homepage, product & feature pages, campaign landing pages, pricing & comparison pages, signup & upgrade flows.
  • Write lifecycle and marketing emails: onboarding sequences, activation nudges, trial & upgrade prompts, win‑back, feature announcements, newsletters.
  • Create ad and social copy for paid campaigns on Google, Meta, LinkedIn; iterate on high‑performing variants.
  • Build campaign and partner landing pages with design and performance marketing; ship without waiting on engineering.
  • Run copy experiments and manage the test backlog: headlines, value propositions, CTAs, form length, pricing framing, social‑proof placement.
  • Translate privacy and compliance language into benefit‑led copy a small‑business owner understands in one read.
  • Keep messaging consistent across the funnel—from ad to landing page to onboarding email—and maintain voice guidelines.
  • Write in‑product growth copy: upgrade prompts, plan limits, paywalls, activation nudges, collaborating with product and design.
  • Partner with SEO and content teams to ensure pages rank and convert.

Requirements

  • 3+ years writing conversion‑focused copy for digital products (websites, landing pages, email, paid campaigns).
  • Strong grasp of UX principles, user flows, interaction patterns, and information hierarchy.
  • Portfolio with outcomes attached (what you wrote, what it replaced, metric impact).
  • Hands‑on experience running A/B tests on copy and reporting results honestly.
  • Working knowledge of an email/lifecycle platform (HubSpot, Customer.io, Klaviyo, Brevo, ActiveCampaign, Intercom, Braze).
  • Comfort with a CMS or page builder (WordPress, Webflow, Unbounce) or headless CMS (Strapi). Familiarity with React‑based front‑end like Next.js is a plus.
  • Understanding of SEO & GEO fundamentals and their effect on conversion copy.
  • Comfortable working in Figma, Claude Design, ChatGPT Codex alongside designers.
  • Fluent, precise English with a keen ear for tone and the judgment to cut unnecessary copy.

Good to Have

  • Experience writing for B2B SaaS products, especially in freemium or free‑trial models.
  • Familiarity with privacy, compliance, fintech, or other regulated domains.
  • Experience writing for a global, largely non‑native English audience.
  • Basic HTML and CSS knowledge.

How to Apply

If this opportunity aligns with your career goals, please share your updated resume with us at careers@mozilor.com.
summary: CookieYes needs a UX Writer to create conversion-focused copy across growth channels and measure impact. Requires 3+ years experience, copywriting, A/B testing, SEO.

job_description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a senior growth leader to own the full customer lifecycle—acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and retention—in a SaaS business > $10M ARR. You will write the growth plan, control the budget, build a team, and deliver weekly experiment results.

Responsibilities

  • Own the growth plan and its implementation; set quarterly targets across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and retention; sequence work and ship it.
  • Own end‑to‑end metrics: sign‑ups, activation rate, free‑to‑paid conversion, cohort retention, churn, expansion revenue, CAC payback.
  • Acquisition: Lead organic, paid, product‑led, AI search, and marketplace channels; allocate budget each quarter.
  • Onboarding: Optimize path from install to live consent banner; work with product to reduce drop‑off and deliver first value quickly.
  • Engagement: Build lifecycle programs via email, in‑app messaging, and in‑product prompts.
  • Retention & Churn: Track cohort retention, diagnose attrition, run win‑back/reactivation, and implement product/support fixes.
  • Expansion: Drive upgrades, usage‑based triggers, and design pricing/packaging tests with product and finance.
  • Build and run experimentation roadmap across website, onboarding, pricing page, in‑app upgrade paths, and lifecycle email.
  • Build growth reporting layer: define key metrics, instrument them, and make data legible to the wider team.
  • Partner with Global Partnerships and Affiliate teams to align channel growth.
  • Manage and mentor a small team of specialists (performance, lifecycle, SEO, AI search) and hire as needed.
  • Own paid budget: allocate, defend with data, and reallocate when metrics change.
  • Run weekly growth review: shipped experiments, results, and decisions.

Ownership & Ways of Working

  • You own the numbers; you decide changes when growth lags.
  • High experiment velocity is expected; prefer many tests over few.
  • No backlog handed to you; you identify constraints and act.
  • Decisions are data‑driven; speed beats perfect planning.
  • Real budget authority with honest reporting obligations.
  • Small, flat team with direct access to leadership; no permission delays.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in growth, performance, or product marketing with direct ownership at a B2B SaaS > $10M ARR.
  • Proven impact on company‑level metrics; provide before/after examples.
  • Full‑lifecycle ownership experience (acquisition, onboarding, retention, expansion).
  • Experience managing a substantial paid acquisition budget and cutting non‑performing spend.
  • Track record of high‑volume experimentation and rapid kill‑off of losers.
  • Ability to translate a growth plan into a sequenced roadmap and deliver quarterly.
  • Strong funnel and cohort analytics skills; proficient in GA4, Mixpanel or Amplitude.
  • Hands‑on paid acquisition on Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn; know when to switch channels.
  • Working knowledge of SEO and content‑led acquisition.
  • Experience building lifecycle/in‑product messaging (HubSpot, Customer.io, Intercom, etc.).
  • Statistical literacy for valid testing.
  • Experience hiring, managing, and holding a small team accountable.
  • Self‑direction and comfort operating without close supervision.

Good to Have

  • Experience with freemium or open‑source models (e.g., WordPress plugins).
  • Exposure to privacy, compliance, security, or developer tooling markets.
  • Experience in product‑led businesses with partner/marketplace channels.
  • Familiarity with AI assistants, AI Overviews, and LLM‑driven discovery/search.

Application

If this opportunity aligns with your career goals, please send your updated resume to careers@mozilor.com.
summary: Lead end‑to‑end growth for a $10M+ ARR SaaS, owning acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention and budget. Drive experiments, reporting and a small specialist team.

job_description:
About the Role

CookieYes publishes a large library of privacy content that businesses worldwide rely on to understand legal requirements. We need a professionally qualified law graduate who writes because they want to, not just to meet a brief. You will track privacy legislation across jurisdictions, translate it into actionable content, and act as the internal check on the legal accuracy of everything we publish and ship. The role also involves genuine legal work: reviewing our own agreements, supporting compliance queries from customers, and keeping our product claims defensible.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor privacy and data‑protection developments globally (GDPR, ePrivacy, CCPA, US state laws, LGPD, PIPEDA, PDPA, emerging regulations) and flag relevant changes for CookieYes and its customers.
  • Write authoritative long‑form content: regulation explainers, jurisdiction guides, compliance checklists, legal update posts, and whitepapers.
  • Review legal accuracy of marketing and product content with an agreed turnaround SLA; no compliance claim ships without your review.
  • Structure content for AI search: collaborate with SEO and AI teams on generative‑engine optimisation, schema, and citation‑worthy formatting.
  • Translate regulatory obligations into product requirements, working with product and engineering on consent, records, and disclosures.
  • Support customer‑facing compliance queries escalated by sales and support; build internal reference material to reduce escalations.
  • Review and maintain internal legal documents (privacy policy, terms of service, DPAs, vendor agreements) with external counsel as needed.
  • Prepare briefing notes for leadership when regulatory changes affect roadmap or positioning.
  • Represent CookieYes publicly through bylined articles, webinars, and industry commentary.

Requirements

  • LLB or equivalent law degree from a recognised institution; bar council enrolment welcome but not required.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in a law firm, in‑house legal team, compliance function, or legal publishing role.
  • Demonstrable writing ability for non‑lawyer audiences (publish work, blog, newsletter, or substantial piece).
  • Ability to write for business owners rather than a bench; accuracy without legalese.
  • Working familiarity with data‑protection law, or clear evidence you can master a regulatory area quickly.
  • Fluency with AI tools for research, drafting, and summarisation, plus discipline to verify every citation against primary sources.
  • Strong research discipline: cite primary sources, check for superseded guidance, avoid building arguments on secondary summaries.
  • Sound judgement on the line between explaining law and giving legal advice.

Good to Have

  • Privacy certification (CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM) or intent to pursue one (support provided).
  • Prior experience at a SaaS, privacy‑tech, or legal‑tech company.
  • Experience drafting or negotiating DPAs and SaaS agreements.
  • Comfort with SEO, GEO, and how legal content performs in traditional search, AI search, and AI Overviews.
  • Additional language ability relevant to EU jurisdictions.
  • Good understanding of major global privacy and data‑protection laws (GDPR, CCPA, DPA, PDPA, UCPA, etc.).

How to Apply

If this opportunity aligns with your career goals, kindly share your updated resume with us at careers@mozilor.com.
summary: Legal writer needed to monitor global privacy laws, create accurate content, and ensure compliance for CookieYes. Requires 2+ years legal experience and strong writing skills.
